QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Whole Lot of House
QuestInfo.0: Renovation of your come is complete! Head back home!
QuestInfo.1:
In place of your tiny little abode, a spacious, cozy, two-story mushroom house has been constructed.

You're going to need a lot of help keeping up all this space. Why not ask Alvin or Amy if they'd be interested in serving as your home's caretaker?
